sources.note: AUC's own programme page for the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program (auucegypt.edu). Read in full: eligibility, award coverage, application steps.
AUC fellowship application deadlines page linked directly from the programme page ('Last Updated : Aug 23, 2026'). Shows the Spring 2027 cycle in progress.
AUC Graduate Admissions page used to confirm the graduate degree levels (master's and PhD) that the fellowship serves.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on AUC's own domain (aucegypt.edu) and is the university's own scholarship page. It describes the programme as run at AUC as part of the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program, with contact mastercardfdn@aucegypt.edu. This matches the record's awarding body (AUC, in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation). The page text renders the university name as 'American University of Cairo (AUC)', a minor wording variant of the same institution.
awarding_body.quote: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at American University of Cairo (AUC) provides full scholarships and comprehensive support to talented young people from across Africa

deadline.detail: The programme page links to AUC's fellowship deadlines page, which shows the currently open cycle: 'Fellowship Application Cycle for Spring 2027' with application start 7 Oct and application deadline 2 Nov (page last updated Aug 23, 2026). Today is 12 October 2026, so this cycle is open and its deadline matches the record exactly (2 November 2026). The same page also lists later Fall 2027 cycles (deadlines 17 Jan and 6 May 2027).
deadline.quote: Fellowship Application Cycle for Spring 2027 ... Application Deadline 2 Nov

eligibility.detail: Every distinct claim in the record is stated verbatim on the programme page: (1) 'Currently residing in an African country and in possession of citizenship of at least one African country'; (2) 'Be aged 35 or younger at the time of application'; (3) 'New graduate degree-seeking students, satisfying AUC graduate admissions requirements. Transfers are not eligible for this fellowship'; (4) "Bachelor's degree with a minimum overall grade point average (GPA) of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent"; (5) 'Showcase financial need.'
eligibility.quote: Currently residing in an African country and in possession of citizenship of at least one African country. Be aged 35 or younger at the time of application.

funding.detail: The page describes 'full scholarships and comprehensive support'. Coverage is extensive and not tuition-only: tuition fees for nine credits per semester, a stipend during fall and spring semesters, a laptop, student services and activities fees, medical service and health insurance, dormitory accommodation for fellows residing outside Cairo, AUC bus subscription or travel allowance, possible coverage of remedial/intensive English, roundtrip airfare for fellows not residing in Egypt, and possible additional funding for research, publication and conference costs. This supports the record's 'Fully Funded' classification.
funding.quote: provides full scholarships and comprehensive support to talented young people from across Africa, enabling them to pursue higher education while developing their leadership potential

degree_levels.detail: The fellowship is for 'New graduate degree-seeking students' at AUC. AUC's Graduate Admissions page confirms AUC offers graduate degrees at both levels: 'With 52 master's programs, two PhD programs and 24 graduate diplomas'. The record's 'Master's, PhD' is consistent with the eligible pool, though the fellowship page itself does not enumerate levels by name.
degree_levels.quote: With 52 master's programs, two PhD programs and 24 graduate diplomas, AUC will help you further your education

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Fellowship Application Cycle for Spring 2027: Application Deadline 2 Nov
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Verified live on 12 Oct 2026 against AUC's own pages. The Spring 2027 fellowship cycle opened 7 Oct 2026 and closes 2 Nov 2026 (page last updated Aug 23, 2026; later Fall 2027 cycles close 17 Jan and 6 May 2027). Note the fellowship deadline is separate from and later than the graduate admission deadline for Spring 2027 (Oct 1, 2026, already passed); applicants must first have an AUC application/ID before submitting the fellowship application. Funding is fully funded, but tuition coverage is capped at nine credits per semester.

notes_for_reviewer: The fellowship's tuition component is capped at nine credits per semester (record does not state a cap) - consider adding this nuance if the catalogue lists funding coverage in detail. Also note the graduate admission application deadline for the Spring 2027 semester (October 1, 2026) has already passed while the fellowship deadline (November 2, 2026) is still open; applicants in that window should confirm with the Office of Graduate Admissions how late applications are handled.
